lead: `cargo test -p nvs-lsp` and `python tools/verify.py` are both green while the `.lspt` corpus is red.
body: Nothing under `tools/` runs `nvs lsp-test`, so the corpus is gated only by the loop's own acceptance checks and a session that changes what a request *answers* hands the driver a failure it did not cause. Run `target/debug/nvs.exe lsp-test tests/lsp/` and `--coverage` after touching an answer, and expect the breakage at a cursor mid-word, where a case froze a list the new arm adds to.
